title: Inconsistency report (mreverse)
description: The structured shape a mreverse reader returns and the aggregate the skill writes alongside the reconciled spec. Documents inconsistencies WITHIN a repo (self-contradiction, drift between modules, dead/duplicated-but-divergent code) and BETWEEN repos (producers/consumers that disagree in their actual code across a shared boundary). Inter-repo findings belong to no single repo, so they are recorded at workspace level (context/project/).

boundary.description: The shared interface / contract boundary compared (cross-repo).

code_refs.description: Source locations evidencing the inconsistency (repo-relative or repos/<repo>/-relative paths).

repos.description: For cross-repo findings, the repos that disagree.
